svg.title: Every Codewhale TUI theme — Truecolor / Paper · page 5/6
svg.desc: Sixteen source presets with their actual backgrounds, status, permission and mode inks. Actual ratatui buffer renders: tui-theme-claude, tui-theme-matrix, tui-theme-solarized-light
